rubric_items.reason: CO-1 to CO-6 are in the head tree as designed: EXISTS weekday filter in the shared WHERE, weekdaysByDoctor with array_agg DISTINCT, oneOf over '1'..'7' plus Number, weekdays only with with_today, both row types, column between Status and Today, filter from WEEKDAYS.

SQL stays in the repository and rules in the service. The query parameter is bound with p(). Invalid weekday goes through Fields.oneOf and f.done() to a 400 ValidationError, as the conventions say. There is no migration and no logging change.

Six files, 55 added and 7 deleted lines. The only test edit is the HMS-6 header test, which pins the column list that CO-6 changes, plus the fixture fields the type change needs. The size check passed.

An absent or empty weekday means Any day, and other values fail with 400. weekdaysByDoctor returns an empty Map for no ids, and the service defaults to []. The page shows No availability for []. The DB CHECK keeps weekday in 1..7, so WEEKDAYS[w - 1] cannot be undefined.
The Summary and Changes sections match the six files in code.files and the edits in each file, including WEEKDAY_VALUES, the worksOn helper, the renamed test and the fixture weekdays.
